Notification NO.NPSC/EXAM-15/2021 dt. 14.09.2026 (Departmental Examination for Typists) 
 Published on : 14-09-2026 04:23 pm 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 
 KOHIMA 
 NO. NPSC/EXAM-15/2021 Kohima Dated, the 14 th September 2026 
 NOTIFICATION 
 This is to inform that the Commission will be conducting Speed-Test in Type Writing at 40 w.p.m and 35 w.p.m for Typist Gr. II & Gr. III who are regular employees and confirmed in service. The speed Test in Type writing will be conducted only for Typist under the establishment of the Directorate, Secretariat and Head of Department, as per Office Memorandum No. AR-3/GEN-174/2007 dated 16/09/08. The Speed Test will be held at the Nagaland Public Service Commission’s Exam Hall, tentatively in the 1 st week of December, 2026. 
 1.The appointing authority may nominate the eligible candidate and forward the nomination letter to the undersigned on or before 31 st October , 2026 . Application received after the last date will not be accepted. 
 2. Further, the Department may direct the nominated candidates to be present for the proposed test with their own Typewriting Machine on the date, time & venue as per routine to be notified at a later date. They should be present at the Examination Hall half an hour before the commencement of the test. 
 3. The list of the eligible candidates, examination routine and further details shall be displayed on the Commission’s Notice Board and Website at https://npsc.nagaland.gov.in in the 2 nd week of November , 2026. 
 4. It may be made clear to the intending candidates that the success in the Speed Test shall confer no right of promotion unless vacancy/vacancies are available in the Department and appointing authority is satisfied that the candidate is eligible for promotion in all respect. 
 5. Further, the appointing authority should ensure that only the regular Typist are nominated for the Speed-Test. The nomination of the eligible incumbent’s should be supported by appointment / promotion order(s). 
 6. The intending candidates are requested to produce their service ID card during the Speed test. 
 (NUNGSANGMENLA IMCHEN) 
 Secretary, 
 Nagaland Public Service Commission, 
 Kohima
